title: Smuggler Crashes Twice During Reckless Escape Attempt
description:
* (Disclaimer: The content in this video is intended for educational and informational purposes only)
Laredo, Texas —  On May 9, 2025, a smuggler in a white Dodge Challenger led TXDPS Troopers on a high-speed vehicle pursuit ion IH-35 in Webb County. During the pursuit, the smuggler, Humberto Misael Garcia, of Laredo, recklessly evaded Troopers, reaching speeds of 100 mph in through neighborhoods. Garcia crashed into a wall, which caused the hood to fly open but he kept driving with the hood up for several miles before disregarding a traffic light that caused him to crash into another vehicle. He then bailed out of the vehicle and led Troopers on a short foot pursuit until a taser was a deployed. Garcia was arrested and charged with smuggling of persons, evading arrest, failure to stop and render aid and reckless driving. Troopers located four illegal immigrants inside the vehicle and referred them to the US Border Patrol.
